title: Street, Road or Driveway Blockage
categories: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
description: This request must be dispatched. Use this service request to report non-emergency concerns regarding vehicles that are blocking the street/roadway/driveway that may be abandoned/unoccupied or disabled in the roadway in need of traffic control until the vehicle is in a safe location or not blocking the roadway 24 hours a day. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 6 hours. ** Please call 911 for emergency conditions or freeway concerns **
instructions: This request must be dispatched. Call 311 to report a non-emergency vehicle blocking a street, roadway, or driveway, including an abandoned, unoccupied, or disabled vehicle that needs traffic control. Call 911 for emergency conditions or freeway concerns.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a non-emergency vehicle blocking a street, road, or driveway.
actions.why: For a non-emergency vehicle blocking a street, roadway, or driveway, including an abandoned or unoccupied vehicle or a disabled vehicle that needs traffic control until it is moved to a safe location or stops blocking the way. The service request must be dispatched and has no online request button.
actions.why_not: This service is not the route for emergency conditions or freeway concerns. If there is an emergency condition, then call 911. If the vehicle blockage is on a freeway, then call 911.
actions.how: Call 311 to report the non-emergency blockage
actions.how_formatted: Call [311](tel:311) to report the non-emergency blockage

actions.tagline: Call 911 about an emergency vehicle blockage.
actions.why: For an emergency condition involving a vehicle blocking a street, road, or driveway. The description for "Street, Road or Driveway Blockage" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs emergency conditions to 911.

actions.tagline: Call 911 about a vehicle blockage on a freeway.
actions.why: For a vehicle blocking a freeway. The description for "Street, Road or Driveway Blockage" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs freeway concerns to 911.
